summary.text: Lisa Fink is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 27, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: In a candidate-submitted profile in the 2024 primary voter guide, Fink is described as president of the Protect Arizona Children Coalition, board president of Choice Academies, and former chairman of the Arizona State Constitutional Commemoration Committee.
The same 2024 profile lists Fink as a member of Mommy Lobby AZ and chairman of the Hometown Christmas Parade in Glendale, and says Fink and husband Larry are parents of six children.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 27 (candidate-submitted statements)
